newsitem.title: USA: Sabratek sued on patent by SIMS Deltec.
newsitem.headline: Sabratek sued on patent by SIMS Deltec.

text.p: SIMS Deltec Inc said Thursday it filed a patent infringement lawsuit in U.S. District Court against Sabratek Inc of Niles, Ill.

The complaint alleges that Sabratek's Mediview Software, in combination with its infusion pump, infringes Deltec's U.S. patent. It asks that Sabratek stop further alleged infringement and seeks unspecified monetary damages.

Sabratek, in a statement, said it intends "to vigorously defend against SIMS Deltec's charges. In particular, Sabratek intends to prove that its Mediview Software does not infringe any valid claim of SIMS Deltec patent."
